panels.title: Latência fim a fim — p50 por protocolo (ms)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "iot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "latency_ms" and r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> group(columns: ["protocol"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: median, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Latência fim a fim — p95 por protocolo (ms)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "iot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "latency_ms" and r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> group(columns: ["protocol"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: (column, tables=<-) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.95, column: column), createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "iot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "seq" and r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> group(columns: ["protocol"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 10.0}))

  |> count()
